Export Downloaded WaPOR Rasters as a NetCDF Cube

Source: R/netcdf_export.R
wapor_export_netcdf.Rd

Reads per-date GeoTIFF files from a wapor_download() cache folder, stacks them in time order, and writes a single CF-compliant NetCDF-4 file. The GeoTIFF cache is preserved unchanged; this is an additional export for interchange with Python (xarray, CDO, Panoply) or other climate tools.

Usage

wapor_export_netcdf(
  folder,
  variable,
  period = NULL,
  output_dir = NULL,
  filename = NULL,
  overwrite = FALSE,
  compression = 4L,
  varname = NULL,
  longname = NULL,
  unit = NULL,
  add_time_bounds = TRUE
)

Arguments

folder

Character. Root download folder (same as the first argument of wapor_download()).

variable

Character. Variable code (e.g. "L1-AETI-D").

period

Optional c(start, end) in "YYYY-MM-DD" to restrict the layers included. Default NULL uses all files found in the folder.

output_dir

Optional override for the destination directory. Default is <folder>/netcdf/<variable>/.

filename

Optional filename. Default is <variable>.<first_date>_<last_date>.nc.

overwrite

Logical. Replace an existing file. Default FALSE.

compression

Integer 1-9, or NA for no compression. Default 4.

varname

Character. NetCDF variable name. Default is the WaPOR variable code with hyphens replaced by underscores.

longname

Character. Human-readable description written as the NetCDF long_name attribute. Default is derived from WaPOR metadata when available, otherwise the variable code.

unit

Character. Physical unit string. Default is read from the first GeoTIFF's stored unit; pass explicitly to override.

add_time_bounds

Logical. Write a CF time_bnds auxiliary coordinate variable encoding each dekad's start and end date. Default TRUE. This preserves the 8-11 day last-dekad duration that is lost when only the start date is recorded.

Value

Character. Path to the written .nc file, invisibly.

Details

The output layout is: <folder>/netcdf/<variable>/<variable>.<start>_<end>.nc

Existing files are overwritten only when overwrite = TRUE. Writes are atomic: the file is written to a .partial.nc sibling and renamed on success.

The function requires the ncdf4 package (a Suggests dependency of terra). An informative error is raised when it is absent.

Values are written in "float" precision (32-bit), consistent with the FLT4S GeoTIFFs written by wapor_download(). Missing values are stored as 1e30 (the NetCDF default for float).

Time is encoded as days since the Unix epoch (1970-01-01) with calendar = "standard". When add_time_bounds = TRUE a time_bnds variable with shape (2, ntime) records the start and end of every dekad.

CF attributes written: Conventions = "CF-1.6", institution, source = "FAO WaPOR v3", created_by, created_date.

See also

wapor_download(), wapor_local_rasters()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# After downloading:
wapor_download("L1-AETI-D", region = my_aoi, period = c("2024-01-01","2024-12-31"),
               folder = "wapor_data")
nc <- wapor_export_netcdf("wapor_data", "L1-AETI-D")
# Open in Python: xr.open_dataset(nc)
} # }
